title: Will o’ the wisp. Gas of graves
html_source:
will-o'-the-wisp
A phosphorescent light that hovers or flits over swampy ground at night, possibly caused by spontaneous combustion of gases emitted by rotting organic matter. Also called friar’s lantern, jack-o'-lantern, ignis fatuus , wisp.
